description: The Parliament & Hemicycle Chart for Power BI is a dedicated custom visual designed to render legislative bodies and assemblies. Whether visualizing a parliament, congress, senate, municipal council, or board of directors, this visual provides an intuitive, publication-ready representation of political party compositions, majority thresholds, and coalition dynamics. Key Features Universal Legislative Layouts: Dynamic semicircle (hemicycle) seating pattern tailored for national parliaments, congressional chambers, senates, and local assemblies. Majority & Coalition Tracking: Highlight specific members or parties with custom color palettes and group ordering. Native Power BI Interactivity: Fully responsive cross-filtering, multi-select highlights, and customizable report tooltips. High-Impact Styling: Granular control over appearance, legend placements, and institutional branding themes. Versatile Use Cases: Ideal for election night dashboards, political party balance tracking, boardroom allocations, and legislative policy research. Built for Data-Driven Governance and Analysis Government & Public Sector: Legislative tracking across parliamentary assemblies, congressional houses, and senates. Media & Journalism: Real-time election result coverage and seat share shifts. Think Tanks & Policy Research: Coalition modeling, voting behavior analysis, and policy impact reporting.…
